prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Sentinel Vale ground excludes spacecraft/launch/external-processing. Mission Control Center(Bluebell:local-voice-only) routes User Services Portal requests/constraints to Mission Planning System(Cedar):screened schedules/command-preparation package/Ephemeris Delta Note schedule-validation;continuous service-hours coverage/state-complete handovers;routine-command authority/role-approved time-limited elevation. Command Validation Gateway(Osprey):independent validation/planning-release segregation;rejects missing authorization/validation/operator-acknowledgment. Uplink requires Mission Control Center/Spacecraft Operations Team concurrence;faults preserve command-state/block discretionary commands/require specialist review. Ground Network Manager(Juniper:standing-rosters):maintenance/anomaly-triage/failover consistency;antenna-baseline acceptance requires current clearances for North S-Band Antenna, South S-Band Antenna, Kiruna X-Band Antenna, Svalbard X-Band Antenna;recovery prioritizes availability/contacts. Network Control System:accepted-ephemeris pointing/Security Exception Ticket restrictions/approved routes/change-logs;rehearses maintenance/station-loss/degraded-routing/restoration. Spacecraft Operations Team receives maneuver recommendation package/Antenna Deicing Notice;uses Pass Replay Packet;leads spacecraft-safety triage;requires integrated day-in-the-life rehearsal(pass-preparation/commanding/telemetry/anomaly/recovery). Orbit Determination Engine produces qualified orbital solution/Doppler Residual Report/Laser Retroreflector Window;Cedar enforces window/suspends publication for security/continuity conflicts. Flight Dynamics Team screens maneuvers/conjunctions;produces Ephemeris Delta Note;assesses orbit/timing degradation;rehearses missed-tracking/late-updates. Flight Dynamics Facility(Mistral:legacy-shift-logs):Star Tracker Mask File/controlled ephemerides/events;orbit-quality notice precedes catalogue-validity update;proves planning-cycle readiness. Gateway mask acceptance requires baseline-integrity/configuration/operator-approval. Telemetry Ingest Service:validation/immutable session-tagged raw staging/metadata/replay. Payload Processing Facility(Forgehouse:consoles/shift-logs) coordinates Primary Processing Cluster;quarantines unproven-lineage inputs/outputs;demonstrates sustained generation with approved-only intervention. Backup Processing Cluster:same image/rules;transfer requires custody/baseline/authorization;Storage Watermark Snapshot verifies standby recovery-capacity. Lantern unresolved;preserve validated routing.

New part:
S244: Operational key performance indicators include contact success rate, telemetry completeness, command validation timeliness, product latency, product quality disposition time, archive availability, help desk responsiveness, and unresolved anomaly age.
S245: Each key performance indicator has an assigned data source, sampling interval, review owner, threshold, and corrective action trigger so that routine reporting does not depend on informal judgment.
S246: The primary monthly service review compares actual performance against the accepted baseline and records trend explanations for any measure that moves outside the watch band.
S247: The Primary Processing Cluster and Backup Processing Cluster are baselined with approved software versions, processing configurations, capacity reservations, monitoring checks, and rollback instructions before handover.
S248: Configuration baselines for ground software, operational procedures, interface control data, account roles, and monitoring rules are frozen at readiness review entry and changed only through approved change control.
S249: Handover to routine mission service is authorized when acceptance evidence is complete, rehearsals meet their objectives, open risks are acknowledged by accountable owners, and support teams confirm on-call coverage.
S250: After handover, the first operational reporting cycle is treated as a stabilization period in which deviations are reviewed daily and permanent process changes are deferred until sufficient evidence is available.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
